name: gnome-same-session-computer-use
description: Operate existing GNOME/Mutter windows with parallel per-window claims and a recoverable focus lease.

interface.shortDescription: Parallel, recoverable control of GNOME apps.
interface.longDescription: Adds concurrent per-window agent claims, stable GNOME window discovery, focused-window capture, and explicitly acknowledged serialized global-seat input transactions which restore focus, workspace, and pointer state.
defaultPrompt: Use my existing logged-in GNOME app to complete this task.
Operate this GNOME window with a recoverable focus lease.
